the CCHT has a good potential to replace the open-type heating tower in a heating tower heat pumps, and the glycerol is an alternative to the traditional CaCl 2 brine for the CCHTs.

the CCHT is a highly efficient and environmentally friendly heating system that can be used to provide space heating for residential and commercial buildings.
